extraction.name: TextVQA
extraction.description: A dataset containing 45,336 questions on 28,408 images from the Open Images dataset that require reading and reasoning about text in the image to answer. Each question-image pair has 10 ground truth answers provided by humans.
extraction.creator: Amanpreet Singh, Vivek Natarajan, Meet Shah, Yu Jiang, Xinlei Chen, Dhruv Batra, Devi Parikh, Marcus Rohrbach
extraction.publisher: Facebook AI Research, Georgia Institute of Technology
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data was collected via a three-stage crowd-sourcing pipeline using images sampled from Open Images v3. In the first stage, annotators identified images without text using a forced-choice yes/no flag to filter them out. In the second stage, annotators provided 1-2 questions per image that required reading the text to answer. In the third stage, 10 answers were collected from annotators for each question.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: User-generated content data, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images from Open Images v3 categories likely to contain text were sampled using category weights based on the average number of OCR boxes detected by the Rosetta OCR system. Images without text and noisy data were filtered out via a crowd-sourcing stage, leaving 28,408 images. Questions were filtered out if a majority of workers flagged options: no text in image, not a question, answering doesn't require reading text, or unanswerable. Hand-crafted questions with known answers were also used to identify and filter out bad annotators.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Crowd-sourced annotators generated 1-2 questions per image ensuring they required reading text. For the second question, annotators were shown the first question and asked for a question requiring reasoning about text with a different answer. Then, 10 ground truth answers were collected per question, with four quality-checking flags provided (no text in image, not a question, answering doesn't require reading text, unanswerable).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: All 10 annotators agree on the most common answer for 22.8% of questions, while 3 or more annotators agree on the most common answer for 97.9% of questions. Questions where a majority of workers marked quality issue flags were removed.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Aims to facilitate progress on assisting visually impaired users, who frequently ask questions of assistive devices that involve reading and reasoning about text in their surroundings.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Question only and Image only baselines achieved 8.09% and 6.29% validation accuracies respectively, showing the dataset does not have significant biases w.r.t. images and questions. The most common answer ('yes') is the majority answer for only 4.71% of the dataset, and yes/no questions make up 5.55%.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: 8.9% of the TextVQA questions can only be answered by combining multiple OCR tokens, which poses a challenge for models limited to single-token copying. OCR models also fail at detecting text that is rotated, unstructured, or partially occluded.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, validation, and testing/benchmarking of Visual Question Answering (VQA) models that read and reason about text in images.
